title: Gear Up
steps: Visit Chuck’s Tackle & Shot in Key Lento.
Buy a long gun and finish the encounter outside the shop.

title: Island Dreams
steps: Meet Kenton at his Key Lento dive shop.
Follow the boat and dive objectives. After the mission, wait for Kenton to send actual wreck assignments.

title: Search the Dive Sites
steps: Wait for Kenton to contact you and mark a wreck. The story introduction alone does not activate every wreck.
Use diving gear and the detector at marked sites, then return the finds. Record the assignments in Leonida to reveal their pins.

title: Tourist Trap
steps: Meet Lucia at the visitor center and follow the bag objective.
Use the marked escape route and follow the final waypoint. This story sequence temporarily closes free roam.

title: What's in the Bag?
steps: In the Starlet Motel room, rotate the statue and flip it to read the note underneath.
Finish inspecting the bag contents and follow the prompts until you can leave the room.

title: Overnight Charges
steps: Leave the room and find the motel reception.
Speak with Linda about the bill. The wall map in reception reveals Port Gellhorn on your in-game map.

title: Just Moved In
steps: Visit the Alpha convenience store across from the motel.
Collect the marked supplies from the shelves and bring them back to the room.

title: Take Care of Jason
steps: Check in with Jason at the motel as you progress through other jobs.
This objective runs across the chapter and finishes during the story.

title: Check Out McKittrick Farm
steps: Once you can leave the motel room, read Kyle's flyer on the outside wall by reception.
Follow the new marker to the airstrip and speak to Kyle. Finish the crop-dusting job and land back at the airstrip.

title: Ambulance Chaser
steps: Exit the motel and follow the marker for the ambulance east of the motel.
Move and dispose of it as directed by the mission prompts.

title: Girl's Trip
steps: Ask around Starlet Motel about Jason's painkillers, then visit Vicki in room 10.
Follow Vicki and the mission markers through the subsequent stops.

title: Pick Up a Gun
steps: Go to Gellhorn Outfitters in Port Gellhorn.
Buy a weapon or retrieve an owned weapon from the green locker.

title: Hit Kingpin Bowling
steps: Use the optional operation marker for Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Look for the unique shotgun case on the pool table. The watch and office safe are separate loot targets.

title: Starlet Motel collectibles
aliases: Help Me Help You Help Me
steps: Look for Victor Maravilla on the kitchen fridge and Vicki beside the toilet in the reception office bathroom.
Check the cafeteria for Wizard Wang and the reception area for Help Me Help You Help Me. Pick up the motel copies while you still have access.

title: Permit Keys rare weapons
steps: The Assassin Nipper is under the hatch in the beached spy vessel west of Maroon Key.
Look for the Smuggler Gorse beside the overturned boat farther north. The Kingfishers W-22 is a separate pickup at the Wetman Bay Fishing Shacks.

title: Gun Nut SMS-01
steps: Find the house in southern Key Lento and go up the exterior stairs.
Check the weapon case on the upstairs kitchen counter.

title: Key Lento collectible cards
steps: Check outside Kenton's dive shop for Marquise Bernard.
Find Wokester on the bench by The Wonder Whale and Santiago Lopez in the trailer west of the original safehouse.

title: Get Shirley's Rum
steps: Meet Shirley near Jason's house before the end-of-chapter sequence.
Ask the clerk at Three Sheets for the rum, then bring it back to Shirley.

title: Steal the Scooter
steps: Finish Shirley's rum errand and wait for her follow-up before Tourist Trap.
Follow the marker for the scooter and deliver it to Shirley's house.
